overview_description.description: Cohere believes in a future in which fossil fuels are superfluous. They believe that this can and will become reality sooner than is often assumed. The challenge lies not in the technology but in effectively bringing together supply and demand of energy, focusing of you as a user first.

competitors_list.target_short_description: Climeworks provides carbon removal solutions using direct air capture (DAC) technology to eliminate CO₂ directly from the atmosphere.
Carbon Engineering uses technology to capture carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and convert it into transportation fuels.
Charm Industrial is putting oil back underground via bio-oil sequestration and industrial syngas production.
Puro.earth is the first B2B marketplace, standard, and registry focused solely on carbon removal.
4.01 is a company that specializes in eliminating CO2 from the atmosphere by mineralizing it in peridotite.
Noya is reversing climate change and pulling CO2 out of the sky by retrofitting existing pieces of equipment to capture carbon.
Project Vesta is a non-profit working to galvanize the science of coastal enhanced weathering
Carbonfuture is the world's leading provider of high-quality durable carbon removal credits.
